Third-party components inside the Vditor 3.11.3 distribution (public/vendor/vditor/dist)
=========================================================================================

Vditor itself is MIT licensed (see LICENSE in this folder). Its dist folder bundles the libraries below.
Components that ship their own licence file keep it next to the code:
  dist/js/highlight.js/LICENSE      highlight.js 11.7.0 (BSD-3-Clause)
  dist/js/wavedrom/LICENSE.WaveDrom WaveDrom 3.6.2 (MIT)
  dist/js/echarts/LICENSE, NOTICE   Apache ECharts 5.5.1 (Apache-2.0)
  dist/js/mermaid/LICENSE           Mermaid 11.x (MIT) and its bundled packages
  dist/js/graphviz/LICENSE          Viz.js 2.1.2 (MIT), Graphviz 2.40.1 (EPL-1.0), Expat (MIT), zlib
  dist/js/lute/LICENSE              Lute 1.7.6 (Mulan PSL v2; the LICENSE file of the Lute repository at v1.7.6)

This distribution was trimmed for this repository: the unused MathJax copy (dist/js/mathjax; the app renders
math with KaTeX), the custom emoji images (dist/images/emoji), the Vditor logo (dist/images/logo.png) and all
highlight.js styles except github and github-dark were removed. The library files themselves are
unchanged; this file, the LICENSE / NOTICE files in dist/js/graphviz, dist/js/mermaid and dist/js/echarts and
dist/js/lute/LICENSE (copied unchanged from the Lute repository) were added for this repository (see THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md at the repository root).

The libraries without a licence file of their own are listed here, followed by the licence texts.

Mulan Permissive Software License v2 (full text in dist/js/lute/LICENSE)
  Lute 1.7.6 (dist/js/lute)            Copyright (c) 2019-present, b3log.org - https://github.com/88250/lute
                                        "Lute is licensed under Mulan PSL v2."
                                        (compiled with GopherJS; contains parts of the Go standard library,
                                        Copyright (c) 2009 The Go Authors, BSD-3-Clause, text B below)

MIT licence (text A below)
  KaTeX 0.16.9 + mhchem (dist/js/katex) Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Khan Academy and other contributors
                                        - https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX (fonts: MIT, same holders)
  markmap 0.14.x (dist/js/markmap)     Copyright (c) 2020 Gerald - https://github.com/markmap/markmap
                                        bundles d3 6.7.0 (ISC, Copyright 2010-2020 Mike Bostock, text C below),
                                        d3-flextree (WTFPL), @gera2ld/jsx-dom (ISC), js-yaml 4.1.0 (MIT,
                                        Copyright (C) 2011-2015 by Vitaly Puzrin), KaTeX CSS (MIT), prism.css (MIT,
                                        Copyright (c) 2012 Lea Verou)
  abcjs 5.10.3 (dist/js/abcjs)          Copyright (c) 2009-2019 Paul Rosen and Gregory Dyke - https://github.com/paulrosen/abcjs
  flowchart.js (dist/js/flowchart.js)   Copyright (c) 2013-present Adriano Raiano - https://github.com/adrai/flowchart.js
                                        bundles Raphael 2.3.0 (MIT, Copyright (c) 2008-2016 Dmitry Baranovskiy,
                                        Sencha Labs) - https://github.com/DmitryBaranovskiy/raphael
  plantuml-encoder (dist/js/plantuml)   Copyright (C) 2015 by Markus Hedvall - https://github.com/markushedvall/plantuml-encoder
                                        includes pako (MIT and zlib licence, Copyright (C) 2014-2017 by Vitaly
                                        Puzrin and Andrei Tuputcyn)
  smiles-drawer (dist/js/smiles-drawer) Copyright (c) 2017 GDB / Reymond Research Group - https://github.com/reymond-group/smilesDrawer
                                        includes chroma.js (BSD-3-Clause, Copyright (c) 2011-2019, Gregor Aisch;
                                        its licence text is kept in a comment inside smiles-drawer.min.js) with the
                                        ColorBrewer colour schemes (Apache-2.0, Copyright (c) 2002 Cynthia Brewer,
                                        Mark Harrower, and The Pennsylvania State University)
  Ant Design icons (dist/js/icons/ant.js) Copyright (c) 2018-present Ant UED, https://xtech.antfin.com/ - https://github.com/ant-design/ant-design-icons

Apache License 2.0 (full text in dist/js/echarts/LICENSE)
  Material icons (dist/js/icons/material.js)  Copyright Google LLC - https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
  diff-match-patch (inside dist/index.js / index.min.js)  Copyright 2018 The diff-match-patch Authors
                                        - https://github.com/google/diff-match-patch

WTFPL
  d3-flextree (inside markmap)          https://github.com/klortho/d3-flextree - WTFPL Version 2:
                                        everyone may copy, modify and distribute it.
